items.title: Local quasi-projectivity is local on the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism is locally quasi-projective exactly when it becomes H-quasi-projective over the members of an open covering of the base. One implication is quoted from the comparison between the two notions. For the other, the question is reduced to an affine base, where the finite type hypothesis supplies a relatively ample invertible sheaf; replacing it by an ample one via the affine criterion makes an immersion into a projective space available, which is precisely H-quasi-projectivity.
